flows.scene_subtitle: attaches to POD 1 scene 2 at g8–g9 (A1001, edge S2: acting on a hedge)

rows.speaker: Sarah
rows.english_text: Can you tell me how far it is into town?

rows.speaker: Passenger
rows.english_text: It's not very far. Maybe three or four miles.

rows.speaker: Sarah
rows.english_text: Three or four miles — I could walk that. I might get off at the next stop, then, and walk the rest. It's a nice morning for it.

rows.speaker: Passenger
rows.english_text: Oh — hold on. There's the sign: six miles to town. It's further than I thought. I'm sorry.

rows.speaker: Sarah
rows.english_text: Don't be — you said maybe, and maybe was right. Six is too far for me. I'll stay in this seat and ride the whole way.

rows.speaker: Passenger
rows.english_text: Do that. It's the last stop, anyway — you can't miss it.

flows.scene_title: I don't know, held with status
flows.scene_subtitle: attaches to POD 1 scene 3 at g14–g16 (A1002, edge M1: the answer being 'I don't know') — the third arm on the canon's yes/no fork

rows.speaker: Sarah
rows.english_text: Do you have crisps, or nuts, or anything?

rows.speaker: Barista
rows.english_text: I honestly don't know — today's delivery is still in its boxes. There might be crisps in there; there might not.

rows.speaker: Sarah
rows.english_text: Would you have a look? No rush — I'm waiting on my coffee anyway.

rows.speaker: Barista
rows.english_text: Right — you're in luck. Crisps, two kinds. No nuts, though.

rows.speaker: Sarah
rows.english_text: Crisps will do nicely — salted, please.

rows.speaker: Barista
rows.english_text: Here's your coffee — and your crisps.

flows.scene_subtitle: attaches to POD 1 scene 4 at g21–g22 (A1006, edge M5: the haggle — your number countered). Price-haggle explicitly NOT attached.

rows.speaker: Sarah
rows.english_text: Hello! I'm sorry but I can't talk at the moment. I need to go home now. Can we talk tomorrow?

rows.speaker: Friend
rows.english_text: No, I'm sorry, I'm busy tomorrow. But let's talk on Saturday. See you then.

rows.speaker: Sarah
rows.english_text: Saturday's good — but only the morning. I'm away all afternoon.

rows.speaker: Friend
rows.english_text: Saturday morning, then. Ten o'clock, at the café?

rows.speaker: Sarah
rows.english_text: Ten at the café — perfect. See you Saturday!

rows.speaker: Friend
rows.english_text: Go on home, then — Saturday at ten!

flows.scene_subtitle: attaches to POD 1 scene 5 at g23 (edge M3: a sceptical challenge landing mid-story). A1004 declared this non-attachable; that verdict predates variant-flow storage and is revised here — the story turn is authored as a variant continuation of the canon's own story invitation, changing no existing row.

rows.speaker: Neighbour (10:30 pm)
rows.english_text: Good evening, Sarah. Did you have a long day?

rows.speaker: Sarah
rows.english_text: Yes, a very long day. It started on the bus this morning — I found out town is six miles away. I nearly got off to walk it!

rows.speaker: Neighbour
rows.english_text: Six miles? Are you sure? I've always thought it was much closer than that.

rows.speaker: Sarah
rows.english_text: I was surprised too — but there's a sign on the road that says six. I saw it myself from the bus.

rows.speaker: Neighbour
rows.english_text: A sign — well then, six it is. I've clearly never looked. Go on — what happened next?

rows.speaker: Sarah
rows.english_text: Coffee, crisps, and a friend I'm seeing on Saturday. And now — bed. Good night!

rows.speaker: Neighbour
rows.english_text: Good night, Sarah. Sleep well — you've earned it.

flows.scene_subtitle: attaches to POD 1 scene 22 at g221–g225 (A1003, edge M2: the premise being audited). The audit rides on the canon's own grant of permission.

rows.speaker: Learner
rows.english_text: Would you mind if I tried to practise speaking [target language] with you? I haven't been learning for very long, and I still feel a little nervous about speaking with other people.

rows.speaker: Friend
rows.english_text: Of course, no problem. Not very long — how long is that, exactly?

rows.speaker: Learner
rows.english_text: About six months. A little every day — usually just ten minutes. It doesn't feel like very much.

rows.speaker: Friend
rows.english_text: Six months, every single day? That's more than most people ever do. I can understand you easily — and now I know why.

rows.speaker: Learner
rows.english_text: Thank you. Maybe it does add up after all. I still feel nervous — but a little less than when we started talking.

flows.scene_subtitle: attaches to POD 1 scene 22 at g227–g228 (A1005, edge M4: the disagreement parked rather than resolved). The canon's g229 follows the last line without a seam.

rows.speaker: Learner
rows.english_text: It's just a little frustrating when I can't think quickly enough to express myself properly. But I know that I need to keep practising if I want to speak more confidently.

rows.speaker: Friend
rows.english_text: You should be confident already. I think you're doing much better than you realise. I feel comfortable speaking with you, and I'm not talking very slowly.

rows.speaker: Learner
rows.english_text: That's kind — but I don't think we're going to agree about this. You hear my sentences; I hear all my gaps.

rows.speaker: Friend
rows.english_text: Then let's leave it there — you hear the gaps, I hear the sentences, and we don't have to settle it now. Keep talking to me, and one of us will be proved right.

rows.speaker: Learner
rows.english_text: It's a deal. Either way, I need the practice — so let's keep talking.
